| [ColumnView](qml-org-kde-kirigami-layouts-columnview.html) | A container that lays out items horizontally in a row |

| [FormData](qml-org-kde-kirigami-layouts-formdata.html) | An attached property with information for decorating a FormLayout |

| [PageStack](qml-org-kde-kirigami-layouts-pagestack.html) | This attached property makes possible to access from anywhere the page stack this page was pushed into |
| [SizeGroup](qml-org-kde-kirigami-layouts-sizegroup.html) | Utility object that makes groups of items request the same size |
